newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Worker killed, eight hurt at Lisbon bridge project.
newsitem.headline: Worker killed, eight hurt at Lisbon bridge project.

text.p: A Portuguese worker was killed and eight men, including a British engineer, were injured on Thursday when a metal support on a bridge being built over Lisbon's river Tagus collapsed.
A spokeswoman for the Lusoponte construction company, an Anglo-French consortium, said that the Britain, named Anthony Freeman, was in a coma. All the injured were taken to hospital.
The accident occured when the metal support broke and plunged some 40 metres to the river bank below.
Some 3,500 workers are employed on building the 18-km (11-mile) Lusoponte bridge which is one of Europe's largest construction projects.
